WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS FLOAT)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) as avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT 
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.avg_quantity,
  ia.avg_cost_ratio,
  ia.avg_quantity - oa.overall_avg_quantity as quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages ia
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ia.avg_quantity > oa.overall_avg_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
